thread:
alice: heads up — CI started failing a few SAST jobs after the RBAC change this morning. getting KMS decrypt errors in scanner runs. anyone else?
ben: saw the same on two PRs, thought it was flaky at first.
carol: can you paste the log line?
alice: here —
```
2026-03-22T10:12:03Z ERROR scanner-runner: failed to fetch signing key: kms:Decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
correlation_id=abc123 job=sast-coverage
```
dave: that matches the RBAC roll I merged at 08:30 — I removed a broad keystore binding and tightened to project-defaults. maybe the scanner SA lost the decrypt role.
security-bot: automated-alert: keystore-audit-gap detected for project/redwood-inference between 2026-03-22T08:25:00Z and 2026-03-22T08:45:00Z — 12 operations missing in auditlog index.
eva: if audit entries are missing we should assume ephemeral grants didn't record. suggest temporary rollback of the binding so CI is unblocked, then recreate with least-priv roles + explicit keystore:Decrypt for scanner SA.
ben: agree. temporary rollback + run sanity. also we should repair evidence for any PRs that failed while audit gaps exist.
carol: for remediation checklist: 1) rollback RBAC tweak, 2) re-run failing SAST jobs, 3) if pass, create constrained binding + record change with runbook entry, 4) backfill audit evidence where possible.
alice: doing rollback now — locking PR and notifying infra.
(alice edits): rolled back, created rollback PR #4578.
ben: re-run CI on the two affected PRs?
security-bot: trigger: ci-retry invoked by alice for jobs [sast-e2e, sast-fast-scan] on PRs 5012, 5019
ben: jobs retriggered, watching logs.
carol: unrelated note — DAST auth tests have been throwing auth-false-positive on staging as well. might be linked if the auth token path touches same keystore.
dave: yes DAST uses the same service account for session token generation in staging. I'll scope a dedicated SA for DAST to isolate permission blast radius.
eva: long-term: we should add pre-merge gate that validates scanner SA permissions via a small smoke step before full SAST matrix. a synthetic check like `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=...` and assert success. add to premerge-runbook.
alice: re-runs are green now for both PRs. looks like rollback fixed it. :thumbsup:
ben: created GH issue #789: "scanner SA least-privilege binding + premerge KMS smoke test" with proposed roles, assignee dave.
carol: also add an alert if keystore audit logs drop below retention threshold or show gaps — security-bot can watch and page on sustained gaps.
security-bot: note logged: watch-rule created by carol for keystore-audit-gap -> page on 5m sustained gap.
dave: I'll make the SA split for DAST today and propose the new IAM bindings.
eva: follow-ups: (a) add premerge smoke test, (b) update playbook with rollback steps and audit-backfill guidance, (c) document how to run `gcloud kms` check locally for SRE/devs.
alice: filing playbook PR and will link to the new GH issue. thanks all.
ben: nice fast turnaround. closing the immediate incident. I'll add postmortem notes to the incident board later.
carol: leaving this thread with action items assigned. ping me if anyone needs help with audit backfill. :white_check_mark:
